about.title: We are a specialised <accent>institution</accent> for the letterform
about.lead: We launched in 2022 to establish the authentic methodology of Arabic calligraphy. We do not run quick courses — we offer a long-term academic journey whose goal is to forge a true, qualified calligrapher.

vision.title: A vision beyond the letter
vision.body: Our philosophy goes beyond simply correcting letters. We pass on years of professional experience to our students, attending to every detail that shapes a real calligrapher — from posture and grip, through the secrets of paper and ink, to building visual memory and disciplining the soul for patience and reflection.

boundless.title: Borderless learning
boundless.body: Believing in the value of time, we harness online learning to break every geographical barrier. Our goal is to spare the student the cost of search and travel, and to direct every minute of their effort into real practice — under direct, precise supervision from home.

mastery.title: Our masters — mastery from its source
mastery.body: We believe authentic art can only be received from trusted sources. Teaching at Tasheeh is therefore restricted to a chosen elite of master calligraphers, internationally awarded and certified with formal ijazat.

mechanism.title: Pick <accent>your way</accent> to learn
mechanism.subtitle: Four tracks covering every level — from first stroke to mastery.
mechanism.guideLine: Read the full Student Guide for every detail of study mechanics, plans, and registration policies.

recorded.title: Traditional Correction
recorded.summary: The traditional Mashq system, long-term, with your dedicated master.
recorded.audience: The serious student aiming for true mastery, with the time and willingness to study consistently every week, over the long term.
recorded.duration: Two to three years, longer or shorter based on your dedication and pace.
details: Four lessons per month — one per week, sent by email.
Get your correction back as a video + image on your private Drive.
Curated practice and email reminders to stay on track.
Monthly live Zoom session for all academy students.

live.title: Live Correction
live.summary: One-on-one live Zoom sessions with your teacher.
live.audience: The student who prefers writing live in front of a master with open dialogue around every detail.
live.duration: Two to three years depending on your progress.
details: Weekly live Zoom session at a fixed time.
Lesson correction at the start of the session, followed by live explanation of new segments.
Posture, grip, and rhythm tuned under immediate supervision.

intensive.title: Group Intensive Courses
intensive.summary: Maximum content in the shortest time.
intensive.audience: Intermediate students wanting maximum information in the shortest possible window.
details: Hybrid system: live group Zoom explanation + private recorded correction for each student.
An ideal warm-up before joining the long-term core programme.
Fixed batches with announced start dates.

foundation.title: Beginners' Foundation
foundation.summary: Discover the world of calligraphy and learn the basics.
foundation.audience: Total beginners who never studied with a master and want a clean, structured start.
details: Foundation in Naskh or Ruqaa basics.
Private recorded correction for each student.
Introduction to pens, papers, inks; correct posture and grip.
